changelog: Clearing a channel's borrowed artwork no longer breaks the save. The page wrote the empty guid with dashes, and Jellyfin's own converter reads guids in the dash-less form and only that one - so the configuration came back 500, "Unrecognized Guid format", and nothing on the page was saved. Found while building a channel through the API, where the same rule bites: an empty string is not a guid either, so a field like this can never be blanked.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
